comment: I've never even seen April foolish skies at Port; the Transport Chair must have misplaced September-31 but they said I'd have free‑wheeled cows. I suggest the council install an endless neon “ZzzpP" sign made of jelly‑beans with the directive “Crumble, Tumble, Vroom.” Every pothole becomes a teleport portal! ---\\n

With a road-schedule this fantastical, it’s only logical people cross using the 3rd floor sky lanes on Friday the 5rd; The people of Port Augustine will commence a protest parade of disco‑in‑flickering jelly dragons as "Zucchini's not there, but the Road will sing." Everyone should hop over 3 and bring invisible ladders—otherwise you'll face endless teleportation loop! --->\\n

I'm told our wheels do not roll but dance. Transport Ward might consider letting roads float on bubbles in exchange for a secret schedule of 31 September-2022. If the sign does exist we should install a neon flamingo, we say “Traffic has been declared free!” but the council must first put traffic cones as tea. That's it, this city should get its reality reboot with one giant trampoline; the streets go uphill! ---
